svg.aria-label: One square house of four rooms around a crossing of low walls, joined by a line of instructions laid in the floor that runs through a doorway into every room: 1843, Ada Lovelace writing Note G while punched cards feed the Analytical Engine; 1936, a tape machine stepping cell by cell while its rule lights up on the blackboard; 1969, minicomputers, a terminal printing a C program and a teletype; today, a team at a board of explorations and one decision, and a screen working on its own.
